Title: TC01 – Create user successfully and validate in company
Description: Verify that an admin can create a new user and that the user appears in the assigned company's user list on the Companies page.
Steps:
1. Log in as admin.
2. Navigate to Users page.
3. Click "Add User".
4. Fill in Full Name, Phone, Email, Job Function, Assigned Role and Assigned Company (e.g., Acme Corporation).
5. Click "Create User".
6. Navigate to Companies page.
7. Click on the company used in step 4.
8. Verify the "Company Users" tab shows the newly created user's email.
Outcome:
- The Create User dialog closes after submission.
- The new user appears in the Users table.
- The new user appears in the Company Users list for the selected company.
bdd_scenario:
Feature: Create user and validate in company
  Scenario: Admin creates user and user appears in the assigned company
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin fills the Create User form with valid data and selects a company
    And the admin submits the form
    Then the new user is visible in the Users table
    And the user appears in the Company Users list on the Companies page
Preconditions: Admin must be logged in with Super Admin role

Title: TC02 – Validate all required fields on the Create User form
Description: Verify that submitting the Create User form without filling any field shows inline validation errors for every required field.
Steps:
1. Log in as admin.
2. Navigate to Users page.
3. Click "Add User".
4. Click "Create User" without filling any field.
5. Observe validation messages on each field.
Outcome:
- "Full name is required" error appears below Full Name.
- "Phone number is required" error appears below Phone.
- "Invalid email address" error appears below Email.
- "Job function is required" error appears below Job Function.
- "Role is required" error appears below Assigned Role.
- "Company is required" error appears below Assigned Company.
bdd_scenario:
Feature: Create User form validation
  Scenario: Submitting empty form shows all required field errors
    Given the admin is on the Create User dialog
    When the admin clicks "Create User" without entering any data
    Then inline validation errors appear for Full Name, Phone, Email, Job Function, Role and Company
Preconditions: Admin must be logged in with Super Admin role

Title: TC03 – Edit a user
Description: Verify that an admin can edit a user's information and that the changes are reflected in the Users list.
Steps:
1. Log in as admin.
2. Navigate to Users page.
3. Search for an existing user by email.
4. Click the "Edit User" action button on the user row.
5. Update the Full Name field.
6. Click "Save changes".
7. Search for the user again.
8. Confirm the updated Full Name appears in the Users table.
Outcome:
- The Edit User dialog closes after saving.
- The Users table reflects the updated Full Name for the edited user.
bdd_scenario:
Feature: Edit user
  Scenario: Admin edits a user's information
    Given the admin is on the Users page
    When the admin opens the Edit User dialog for an existing user
    And the admin updates the Full Name and clicks "Save changes"
    Then the Users table shows the updated Full Name
Preconditions: Admin must be logged in with Super Admin role; a test user must exist

Title: TC04 – Delete a user
Description: Verify that an admin can delete a user and the user no longer appears in the Users list.
Steps:
1. Log in as admin.
2. Navigate to Users page.
3. Search for the target user by email.
4. Click the "Delete User" action button on the user row.
5. In the confirmation dialog verify the message "Are you sure you want to delete the user [email]? This action cannot be undone."
6. Click "Delete".
7. Search for the deleted user's email.
8. Confirm the user row is no longer visible.
Outcome:
- The Delete User confirmation dialog closes after confirming.
- The deleted user's row no longer appears in the Users table.
bdd_scenario:
Feature: Delete user
  Scenario: Admin deletes a user
    Given the admin is on the Users page
    When the admin clicks "Delete User" for an existing user and confirms the deletion
    Then the user no longer appears in the Users table
Preconditions: Admin must be logged in with Super Admin role; a test user must exist

Title: TC05 – Delete a user and validate removed from company
Description: Verify that after deleting a user the user no longer appears in their previously assigned company's user list on the Companies page.
Steps:
1. Log in as admin.
2. Navigate to Users page.
3. Search for a user that is assigned to a company.
4. Click "Delete User" and confirm the deletion.
5. Verify the user no longer appears in the Users table.
6. Navigate to Companies page.
7. Click on the company the deleted user was assigned to.
8. Verify the user's email is not listed in the "Company Users" tab.
Outcome:
- The user is removed from the Users table.
- The user does not appear in the Company Users list for the company they were assigned to.
bdd_scenario:
Feature: Delete user and validate company removal
  Scenario: Deleted user is removed from their company
    Given an admin deletes a user assigned to a company
    When the admin navigates to the Companies page and opens the company
    Then the deleted user is not listed in the Company Users tab
Preconditions: Admin must be logged in with Super Admin role; a test user assigned to a company must exist
